user.title: Welcome to DayMill
user.description: Found: {found}. Pick your system and DayMill fills in the sensors for you.

no_solar.title: Welcome to DayMill
no_solar.description:
DayMill didn't find any solar in Home Assistant yet.

**SunPower:** install [pvs-hass]({pvs_url}). The password is the last 5 characters of your PVS serial number. Turn on live data and keep polling at 15 seconds or more.

**Other brands:** add [your solar integration]({integrations_url}) first.

Then come back here, or try DayMill with demo data.

data.grid_positive_is_import: Positive grid power means buying from the grid

data_description.solar_power: Your fastest-updating solar power sensor. W and kW both work.
data_description.solar_power_fallback: Optional. A slower meter used when the one above stops updating.
data_description.grid_power: Net power to or from the grid.
data_description.grid_power_fallback: Optional. A slower meter used when the one above stops updating.
data_description.grid_positive_is_import: Turn off if your grid sensor goes positive when you send power out.
data_description.home_power: Optional. Without it, DayMill works it out from solar and grid.
data_description.solar_energy: A counter that only goes up.
data_description.import_energy: A counter that only goes up.
data_description.export_energy: A counter that only goes up.
data_description.max_age: How long a sensor can go without updating before DayMill uses its backup.

panels.title: Panels (optional)
panels.description: Found {count} panels. Group them into roof faces so DayMill can compare panels that face the same way and spot one that's falling behind. Set roof faces to 0 to skip.

data_description.roof_faces: How many groups of panels point in different directions.
data_description.gateway_uptime: Optional. DayMill flags the gateway as offline when this goes unavailable.
data_description.gateway_diagnostics: Optional. Extra gateway sensors to show on the panels page.

panel_face.title: Roof face {number} of {total}
panel_face.description: Name this roof face and pick its panels.

data_description.label: For example Front or Garage.
data_description.panels: The power sensor of each panel on this face.

battery.title: Home battery (beta)
battery.description:
{found} Leave both sensors empty if you don't have a battery.

Battery support is new. If the numbers look off, please open an issue.

data.battery_positive_is_discharge: Positive power means the battery is discharging

data_description.battery_power: Power going in or out of the battery.
data_description.battery_positive_is_discharge: Turn off if your sensor is positive while charging.

cars.title: Cars

car_add.title: Add a car
car_add.description: Pick a car or charger DayMill found. Its sensors get filled in for you.

car.title: Car details

data_description.image: Used on the house card. You can upload your own in the card editor.
data_description.presence: Optional. A tracker that reads home when the car is home. Without it, charging always counts as at home.
data_description.charging: On (or charging) while the car is charging.
data_description.plugged: On while the cable is plugged in.

rates.title: Utility rates
rates.description: Rate presets are unofficial estimates. Check them against your bill.

data_description.nem: How your utility credits power you send to the grid. NEM 3.0 is in beta.
data_description.cycle_day: Day of the month your bill starts (1-28).
data_description.track_cost: Turn off to only track energy, with no money sensors.

nem3.title: NEM 3.0 settings
nem3.description: Used for export credit, the ACC Plus adder and the annual true-up. Leave a field empty if you don't know it.

data_description.pto_date: The date your utility let the system turn on. Sets the price lock-in, the ACC Plus rate and the true-up date.
data_description.acc_plus_class: Which ACC Plus rate applies to you.
data_description.arecr: Optional, in $/kWh. Taken off leftover export credit at true-up for net surplus kWh.
data_description.nsc_opt_in: Turn on if you signed up to be paid for net surplus kWh at true-up.

finish.title: All set

frontend_resource_yaml.title: Add the DayMill cards to your dashboard resources
frontend_resource_yaml.description:
Your dashboard resources are managed in YAML, so DayMill can't add its cards for you. Add this to the `resources` list in your Lovelace YAML and restart Home Assistant:

```yaml
- url: {url}
  type: module
```

tariff_out_of_date.title: Your rate plan may be out of date
tariff_out_of_date.description: The {tariff} prices in DayMill are from {date}, over a year ago. Your utility has probably changed them since, so cost numbers may be off. Check for a DayMill update, or pick another plan in [DayMill's options]({options_url}).

source_unavailable.title: DayMill can't read some sensors
source_unavailable.description:
These sensors have been missing or unavailable for over an hour: {entities}

Check the integration they come from, or pick other sensors in [DayMill's options]({options_url}).
